body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2011') -- <Visual News> Liquid Image unveiled the 'Scuba Series HD Wide Angle' and 'VideoMask Series'2011 CES Unveiled.

'Scuba Series HD Wide Angle' that has an integrated water resistant High Definition 720P digital video camera plus 5.0MP photographs. Operates to a depth of 130ft / 40m and eliminates the need to hand carry an underwater camera. Ideal for scuba diving and may also be used for snorkeling, snuba, spearfishing, and freediving. The Wide Angle lens more than doubles the current Scuba Series HD's field of view to capture all the action underwater in High Definition while snorkeling or scuba diving.

Also, 'VideoMask Series' is the world's only dive mask that has an integrated waterproof digital video camera plus photographs at 5mp. Operates to a depth of 65ft / 20m and eliminates the need to hand carry an underwater camera. Ideal for snorkeling, snuba, spearfishing, freediving, shark cage diving and shallow scuba diving.
